verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable event rules or triggers in Vercel Sandbox. Sandboxes are created and driven imperatively through the SDK and CLI. Auto-snapshot on stop is fixed built-in behavior, not a rule the user defines. Spend Management alerts and project pausing are a Vercel host-platform cost control, an adjacent feature rather than an event-rule capability of the Sandbox product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
